title: RemotePathChangedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'remote.path.changed'. STATE.md "Loombre Remote — embedded WireGuard + three-path wizard + reachability proof + posture card" (R8/RG15): emitted whenever the DERIVED active path (GET /admin/remote/state's activePath, RemotePathId in openapi.yaml — never a stored setting) transitions, including to/from 'none'. Lets the admin-only event stream (and a future posture-card live update) observe path switches without polling GET /admin/remote/state. ADMIN-ONLY delivery, same posture as remote.enabled.
